meta.name: Create sustained capacity review tasks from OpenObserve metrics to Twenty CRM

name: Detect sustained infrastructure pressure with OpenObserve

parameters.content:
## Detect sustained infrastructure pressure with OpenObserve

### How it works

This workflow detects sustained infrastructure pressure by running either manually or every 30 minutes, applying a capacity policy, and querying historical metrics from OpenObserve. It validates the metric window, assesses pressure and data coverage, then prepares per-resource capacity review recommendations. For each resource, it optionally creates or refreshes a review task in Twenty CRM, records the action taken, and produces a final capacity findings report.

### Setup steps

- Configure the OpenObserve credentials and ensure the PromQL query targets the correct organization, stream, and metric data.
- Configure the Twenty CRM credentials and verify the task object/fields used for finding, creating, and updating capacity review tasks.
- Review the capacity policy values, including rule_key, promql, window_minutes, and step_seconds.
- Enable or adjust the 30-minute schedule trigger when moving from preview/testing to production monitoring.

### Customization

Adjust the PromQL expression, query window, sustained-pressure criteria, and CRM write conditions to match the infrastructure signals and escalation process you want to enforce.

## Start and set policy

Provides the manual preview and scheduled execution entry points, then initializes the capacity policy used by the rest of the workflow.

## Validate query window

Checks the configured capacity policy and calculates the metric history window before querying OpenObserve.

## Analyze metric pressure

Queries OpenObserve for infrastructure metric history, assesses sustained pressure and data coverage, and prepares resource-level review recommendations.

## Loop resource decisions

Iterates through each resource recommendation, decides whether a CRM review task should be written, and records findings that do not require a CRM write.

## Plan CRM task action

Searches Twenty CRM for an existing capacity review task and determines whether the workflow should update it or create a new one.

## Refresh existing task

Updates an existing Twenty CRM capacity review task and records the refresh before returning to the resource loop.

## Create new task

Creates a new Twenty CRM capacity review task and records the creation before returning to the resource loop.

## Report capacity findings

Compiles and outputs the final capacity findings after resource processing is complete.
